note: Adapted from entry 300 in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate are all described; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated, and fine structures such as wing microsculpture are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow, with a reddish tinge to chestnut brown; fontanelle gland area pale; nasus brown, darker near the apex; antennae brownish yellow; abdominal tergites brown to rusty brown; legs and sternites milky white. Vertex with a pair of long setae, base of the nasus with a pair of long setae, sometimes with several additional ones; without microscopic setae; abdominal tergites bare, sternites with short setae. Body length 4.00–5.30 mm. Head robust, broad and flat, transversely oval, wider than the length without nasus; length with nasus 1.90–2.10 mm, length without nasus 1.10–1.30 mm, width 1.30–1.50 mm; in lateral view nearly straight, without a nasus hump. Nasus short, conical, robust, hairy at the apex; length 0.70–0.85 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.58–0.68. Antennae 13–14-segmented, usually 13-segmented; the third segment almost twice as long as the second, the fourth shorter than the second; in the 14-segmented condition the third nearly as long as the second. Mandibles reduced, each with a short brown spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped; length 0.30–0.35 mm, width 0.60–0.65 mm; anterior margin rounded, not or only slightly concave; posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to smoky brown; pronotum paler than the head; antennae and postclypeus straw yellow; abdominal tergites light brown, sternites yellowish white. Head sparsely hairy, body moderately hairy. Body length 4.00–5.50 mm. Head nearly square and rounded; length to the base of the mandibles 1.20 mm, width 1.44 mm; coronal suture faintly visible. Fontanelle spot elongate-oval. Antennae 14-segmented, the third segment much longer than the second, the fourth nearly as long as the second. Postclypeus short, swollen, hairy, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; length 0.30 mm, width 0.95 mm; anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae and postclypeus brownish; pronotum deep straw-coloured to light brown; abdominal sternites light brown. Head and body densely hairy; distal half of the wing with short setae. Body length with wings 16.50–17.00 mm, without wings 7.50–8.50 mm. Head nearly circular; length to the base of the mandibles 1.30 mm, width including eyes 1.70–1.79 mm; coronal suture absent. Fontanelle area elongate, translucent, narrow. Compound eyes large, nearly circular, projecting, maximum diameter 0.60 mm. Ocelli large, oval, long diameter 0.20 mm, adjacent to the compound eyes, almost touching them, eye–ocellus distance 0.025 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, the third segment slightly longer than the second, the fourth shorter than the second. Postclypeus slightly swollen, hairy, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum trapezoidal; length 0.80–0.84 mm, width 1.30–1.40 mm; anterior margin slightly raised, not concave; posterior margin slightly concave. Wings straw-coloured, membrane hairy; fore wing length 14.0–14.50 mm, hind wing length 14.0 mm.
